influences.name: Kanye West

influences.name: Rezzett
influences.context: I've probably listened to Rezzett the most out of anyone over the past year. I put on their tapes, driving around LA and it works so well. I got into Rezzett through their Live In Japan mix tape.

influences.name: Bones
influences.context: I have weird tastes, there's this rapper from LA called Bones who I listen to quite a bit.

influences.name: Gucci Mane
influences.context: What you create into the world is different to what you consume, they satisfy different needs. It could be Gucci Mane one day and Rezzett the other.

influences.name: Sonic Youth
influences.context: I grew up in Vancouver around the time when Nirvana was just cusping formative shows, things like Sonic Youth with Nirvana opening and the Bleach album era.
